# LunaVerta: full reference

> LunaVerta is a free file converter and PDF editor that runs entirely in the web browser. Files are processed on the user's own device and are never uploaded to a server. It works offline after the first visit, needs no account, sets no cookies and shows no ads. LunaVerta is made in Denmark by Midt-Tech.

This file describes every LunaVerta tool and guide in full. The short version is https://lunaverta.com/llms.txt. Every tool page also exists in Danish, German, Spanish, French, Norwegian, Swedish; the addresses are listed in llms.txt.

## How LunaVerta works
- Files are opened, converted and saved by the browser on the user's own device. LunaVerta has no server that receives files, so nothing is uploaded. This can be checked by going offline or watching the browser's network tab.
- No account, no cookies, no tracking, no ads. Free to use.
- Works offline after the first visit; some tools fetch a helper library (for example OCR language data) the first time they are used.
- Large files are limited only by the memory of the user's device.
- Made and run by Midt-Tech, Aarhus, Denmark (CVR 34256276). Contact: lee@midttech.com.

## Tools

### HEIC to JPG
https://lunaverta.com/heic-to-jpg/

Turn iPhone photos (HEIC) into JPG that opens everywhere. The conversion runs on your own device, so your photos are never uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose your HEIC photos, or drop them on the page.
2. LunaVerta converts them to JPG straight away.
3. Save the photos one by one, or all at once as a .zip.

Questions:
- Why are my iPhone photos HEIC? iPhones save photos as HEIC by default because the files are about half the size of JPG. Many Windows programs and websites cannot open HEIC, which is why converting to JPG helps.
- Do I lose quality? Very little. Set the image quality (90% by default) to choose between the best quality and a smaller file.

### Word to PDF
https://lunaverta.com/word-to-pdf/

Turn Word documents (.docx) into PDF with the page layout, fonts, colours, tables, images, headers and footers intact. Your document never leaves your device.

Steps:
1. Choose your Word document (.docx), or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta lays it out like Word and makes a PDF.
3. Save the PDF. The text stays searchable.

Questions:
- Can I make the PDF smaller? Yes. Under settings, set Word to PDF to Small file. The PDF becomes about 60% smaller, which is handy for e-mail.
- Does it work with old .doc files? No, only .docx. Open a .doc file in Word and save it as .docx first.

### Merge PDF
https://lunaverta.com/merge-pdf/

Combine several PDFs, and images if you like, into one PDF. Pages keep their quality, text and links. Everything happens on your device.

Steps:
1. Choose two or more PDFs, or drop them on the page.
2. Drag the files into the order you want.
3. Press MERGE and save the combined PDF.

Questions:
- Can I add images too? Yes. JPG, PNG, HEIC and other images become pages in the PDF. At least one of the files must be a PDF.
- Is there a limit to how many files I can merge? No fixed limit. Very large files use more memory, so merge in a few rounds if your device slows down.

### Split PDF
https://lunaverta.com/split-pdf/

Turn every page of a PDF into its own PDF file. Handy when you only need to send one page. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta splits it into one PDF per page.
3. Save the pages, which come together in a .zip.

Questions:
- Can I pick only some pages? Use Edit to delete the pages you don't need, or split and keep the files you want.
- Do the pages keep their quality? Yes. Pages are copied as they are, with text, images and links.

### Compress PDF
https://lunaverta.com/compress-pdf/

Make large PDFs smaller so they fit in an e-mail. Scanned and image-heavy PDFs often shrink by 60% or more, and the text stays searchable.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta redraws the pages more compactly.
3. Save the smaller PDF. If it can't get smaller, you get the original back.

Questions:
- How much smaller does it get? It depends on the PDF. Scans and PDFs with many pictures often shrink by 60% or more. PDFs that are mostly text are usually small already.
- Can I still select and search the text? Yes. LunaVerta keeps a text layer, so you can search and copy text in the smaller PDF.

### Protect PDF
https://lunaverta.com/protect-pdf/

Lock a PDF with a password before you send it, for example a payslip, a contract or anything with a CPR number. The PDF is encrypted with AES-256 on your own device.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Type the password twice and press Protect.
3. Save the protected PDF. It asks for the password when it is opened.

Questions:
- How safe is it? The PDF is encrypted with AES-256, the strongest encryption PDFs support. Without the password the content can't be read. Choose a long password that is hard to guess.
- What if I forget the password? Then the PDF can't be opened, not even by LunaVerta. The password is never stored or sent anywhere, so keep it somewhere safe.
- Is my password uploaded? No. The encryption happens in your browser, and neither the PDF nor the password leaves your device.

### Unlock PDF
https://lunaverta.com/unlock-pdf/

Tired of typing the password every time? If you know the password, LunaVerta makes a copy without it. You need the password: LunaVerta does not crack PDFs.

Steps:
1. Choose a password-protected PDF.
2. Type its password and press Unlock.
3. Save the copy without a password.

Questions:
- Can it open a PDF if I don't know the password? No. You need the password the PDF opens with. LunaVerta does not guess or crack passwords.
- Is anything else changed? No. The pages, text, links and form fields stay as they are. Only the password and encryption are removed.

### OCR: make a PDF searchable
https://lunaverta.com/ocr-pdf/

A scan is just a picture of text. OCR reads the words and adds them as invisible text on the page, so you can search, select and copy. It runs on your own device and reads English, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, Spanish and French.

Steps:
1. Choose a scanned PDF or a photo of a document.
2. LunaVerta reads the text on each page. The first time, the language data (about 5 MB) is loaded.
3. Save the searchable PDF. It looks exactly like before.

Questions:
- Is my document uploaded for OCR? No. The text recognition runs in your browser, on your own device.
- Which languages does it read? English, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, Spanish and French. It reads Danish and English unless you choose another language under Settings, OCR language. The language data (about 2 MB) is fetched the first time and then kept on your device, so it works offline too.
- What about pages that already have text? They are left as they are; only pages without text are read.
- Can I remove names or prices from a scan afterwards? Yes. Open the searchable PDF in the editor and use Remove sensitive: the found text is painted over and the page is saved as a picture, so nothing is left.

### Remove prices from PDF
https://lunaverta.com/remove-prices-from-pdf/

Share a quote or order without the prices. LunaVerta finds the amounts on every page and leaves measurements, quantities, percentages, dates and other numbers alone. You check the marks, then save a new version.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF. Every price is found and marked in yellow on the pages.
2. Click a mark to keep that price, or search for anything else to remove.
3. Press Remove and save new version. The prices are deleted from the copy; your original is untouched.

Questions:
- How does it tell prices from other numbers? A number counts as a price when it has a currency (kr., DKK, €, ,-), is written like money (18.175,94), or stands in a column of prices or on a line about money. Measurements, quantities, weights, technical values, dates and order numbers are left alone.
- Are the prices really gone? Yes. The digits are deleted from the PDF, not covered, so they can't be copied or searched for. You can also choose a black box instead.

### Redact PDF
https://lunaverta.com/redact-pdf/

Remove names, ID numbers, prices and other confidential details before you share a PDF. LunaVerta finds them for you, and the text is deleted from the file itself, so it can't be copied or searched.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF. LunaVerta looks for amounts, CPR numbers, account numbers, e-mails, phone numbers, addresses, dates and reference numbers.
2. Click a suggestion to mark all of it, and click marks on the pages (or in the list) to keep or remove each one. Search for any other word, or drag black boxes by hand.
3. Press Remove and save new version. The text is deleted from the copy; your original is untouched.

Questions:
- Is the text really gone, or just hidden? It is really gone. LunaVerta deletes the letters under each box from the PDF and rewrites the file, so nothing is left to copy or uncover. Form fields and comments under a box are removed too.
- What about pictures and scans? If a box covers a picture or a scanned page, that page is saved as an image with the black box burned in, so nothing under the box survives.
- Can I remove all prices at once? Yes. Press Find & remove, choose Amounts (or search for any word or number), tick the hits and remove them all in one go, on every page. You choose whether the text is simply deleted or blacked out.
- Is my PDF uploaded? No. Everything happens in your browser.

### Remove PDF metadata
https://lunaverta.com/remove-pdf-metadata/

PDFs often carry more than their pages: the author's name, the program and dates, attached files, scripts and comment notes. LunaVerta removes it all and keeps the pages as they are.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta removes metadata, attachments, scripts and notes.
3. Save the clean PDF. The result shows what was removed.

Questions:
- What is removed? Document information (author, title, program, dates), XMP metadata, attached files, JavaScript and automatic actions, and comment notes. The visible pages, links and form fields stay.
- Does it also black out text? No. To remove text on the pages, use Redact PDF.

### Edit PDF
https://lunaverta.com/edit-pdf/

Correct existing text, write new text, fill in forms, and reorder, rotate or delete pages. The editor runs in your browser, so the PDF never leaves your device.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Rearrange pages, or open a page to edit its text or fill in fields.
3. Press Save PDF. The edited copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Can I change text that is already in the PDF? Yes. Open a page, press Edit text and click a line to change or delete it. Text you delete is removed from the PDF itself, not covered with a white box, and the rest of the line keeps its original font. Changed text is written in a matching standard font.
- Does the form stay fillable? Yes. Form fields you fill in keep working, so the PDF can still be filled in later.
- Can I move text or whole paragraphs, also to another page? Yes. Press Move text, then click a paragraph or drag a frame over the lines you want. The text becomes a box you can rewrite, make wider or narrower, give a bigger font, and drag anywhere, also onto another page. The text around it does not move up by itself.

### Sign PDF
https://lunaverta.com/sign-pdf/

Draw your signature with the mouse or a finger, or upload a picture of it, and place it anywhere on the page. Everything happens on your own device.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Draw or upload your signature, then click where it should go.
3. Press Save PDF. The signed copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Is this a legal electronic signature? It adds a picture of your handwritten signature, which is fine for most everyday documents. It is not a certified digital signature like MitID signing.
- Is my signature saved? Only if you choose to save it, and then only in your own browser so you can reuse it. It is never uploaded.
- Can I add the date? Yes. Tick Add today's date under the signature, and the date is written under it in your language, for example 31 October 2026.

### Delete PDF pages
https://lunaverta.com/delete-pdf-pages/

See all pages as thumbnails, remove the ones you don't need and save a new PDF. The pages are really removed, so the file gets smaller too.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Press the bin on each page you want to remove.
3. Press Save PDF. The shorter copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Can I change my mind? Yes. A deleted page can be brought back with one click until you save. Your original file is never changed.
- Can I also reorder pages? Yes. Drag the thumbnails into the order you want before you save.

### Rotate PDF
https://lunaverta.com/rotate-pdf/

Turn pages that were scanned sideways or upside down. Rotate one page or all of them, then save a new PDF. The file never leaves your device.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Press the rotate button on each page that needs turning.
3. Press Save PDF. The corrected copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Does rotating lower the quality? No. The page is turned, not redrawn, so text and pictures stay exactly as sharp as before.
- Can I rotate every page at once? Yes. Rotate the pages one by one in the overview; it only takes a click per page.

### Add page numbers
https://lunaverta.com/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/

Put page numbers on every page: choose where they go and how they look, such as 1, 2, 3 or Page 1 of 10. Everything happens on your device.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Pick the position and style of the numbers.
3. Press Save PDF. The numbered copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Can the numbering start at another number? Yes. Choose the first number, for example when the PDF continues another document.
- Can I add a watermark too? Yes. The same window has a watermark and a stamp, such as Copy or Draft.

### Watermark PDF
https://lunaverta.com/watermark-pdf/

Write a watermark such as Copy, Draft or Confidential across every page. Choose the text, colour and how strong it is. The PDF never leaves your device.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Write the watermark text and pick colour and strength.
3. Press Save PDF. The marked copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Can the watermark be removed again? It is drawn onto every page of the new PDF, so it can't simply be clicked away. Keep your original if you need a clean copy.
- Can I add a stamp instead? Yes. The same window has stamps such as Approved or Paid that you place on a single page.

### Fill in PDF form
https://lunaverta.com/fill-pdf-form/

Type in the fields, tick the boxes and choose from the lists, then save. Forms without fields work too: just write anywhere on the page.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF form, or drop it on the page.
2. Click a field and type, or press Add text to write anywhere.
3. Press Save PDF. The filled-in copy is saved on your device.

Questions:
- What if the form has no fields? Press Add text and click where you want to write. You can also add your signature.
- Can someone else still edit the form afterwards? Yes. Filled-in fields keep working, so the form can be changed again later.

### PDF to JPG
https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-jpg/

Turn each page of a PDF into a sharp JPG image, ready for presentations, social media or a website. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Each page becomes a JPG image.
3. Save the images, which come in a .zip when there are several pages.

Questions:
- How sharp are the images? Pages are drawn at about 150 dpi. Use Longest side to make them smaller.
- Can I get PNG instead? Yes, see PDF to PNG, or pick PNG in the ring.

### PDF to PNG
https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-png/

Turn each page of a PDF into a lossless PNG image, ideal for text and diagrams that should stay crisp. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Each page becomes a PNG image.
3. Save the images, which come in a .zip when there are several pages.

Questions:
- PNG or JPG? PNG keeps text and lines perfectly sharp but makes bigger files. JPG is smaller and fine for photos.
- Are my PDFs uploaded? No. The pages are drawn in your browser.

### JPG to PDF
https://lunaverta.com/jpg-to-pdf/

Put photos and scans into one PDF, one page per image, or make a PDF per image. Works with JPG, PNG, HEIC and more. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose your images, or drop them on the page.
2. Drag them into order if you want one combined PDF.
3. Save the PDF.

Questions:
- One PDF or one per image? By default all images go into one PDF. Untick Merge images into one PDF under settings to get a PDF per image.
- Which image formats work? JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, GIF, BMP and SVG.

### PNG to JPG
https://lunaverta.com/png-to-jpg/

Turn PNG images into JPG, which is often several times smaller. Transparent areas become white. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose your PNG images, or drop them on the page.
2. They become JPG straight away.
3. Save them one by one or all at once as a .zip.

Questions:
- What happens to transparency? JPG cannot be transparent, so transparent areas become white. Keep PNG or choose WebP if you need transparency.
- Can I resize at the same time? Yes. Set Longest side under settings before converting.

### WebP to JPG
https://lunaverta.com/webp-to-jpg/

Many websites serve images as WebP, which older programs cannot open. Turn them into JPG in a second, on your own device.

Steps:
1. Choose your WebP images, or drop them on the page.
2. They become JPG straight away.
3. Save them one by one or all at once as a .zip.

Questions:
- Can I convert to PNG instead? Yes. Pick PNG in the ring or under Convert all to.
- Is it free? Yes, with no limits, no account and no watermark.

### Remove photo location
https://lunaverta.com/remove-location-from-photos/

Photos from phones often contain the exact GPS location where they were taken. Remove it, along with camera details and dates, before you share them. The picture itself is not changed.

Steps:
1. Choose your photos, or drop them on the page.
2. LunaVerta removes location, camera details and other hidden data.
3. Save the cleaned photos and share them safely.

Questions:
- Does the photo lose quality? No. JPG, PNG and WebP photos are cleaned without re-saving the image, so the picture is identical to the original.
- What exactly is removed? EXIF data (GPS location, camera model, dates), XMP and IPTC data and comments. Photos taken sideways are redrawn upright so they still show the right way round.

### Excel to CSV
https://lunaverta.com/excel-to-csv/

Turn Excel workbooks into CSV files for import into other systems. Workbooks with several sheets give one CSV per sheet. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose your Excel file (.xlsx, .xls or .ods), or drop it on the page.
2. Each sheet becomes a CSV file.
3. Save the CSV, or the .zip if there are several sheets.

Questions:
- Will Danish letters (æ, ø, å) work? Yes. The CSV is saved as UTF-8 with a marker, so Excel opens it with the right letters.
- Can I get JSON instead? Yes. Pick JSON in the ring to get the data as JSON.

### CSV to Excel
https://lunaverta.com/csv-to-excel/

Turn CSV, TSV or JSON data into a proper Excel workbook (.xlsx) that opens with columns in place. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose your CSV, TSV or JSON file, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta builds an Excel workbook.
3. Save the .xlsx file.

Questions:
- Does it handle semicolons? Yes. Comma- and semicolon-separated files are both recognised.
- Can JSON become several sheets? Yes. A JSON object with lists becomes one sheet per list.

### Excel to PDF
https://lunaverta.com/excel-to-pdf/

Turn a spreadsheet into a neat PDF table: headings repeated on every page, amounts lined up, wide sheets turned sideways. The text stays real and selectable. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose your Excel, CSV or ODS file, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta lays out each sheet as a table on A4 pages.
3. Save the PDF.

Questions:
- What happens with wide sheets? The page turns sideways, and the text gets smaller until every column fits.
- Are all sheets included? Yes. Each sheet starts on a new page with its name at the top.

### PDF to Excel
https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-excel/

Get the tables out of invoices, statements and reports into Excel. Rows and columns are rebuilt from the page, and amounts become numbers you can add up. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta reads the text on each page and rebuilds the rows and columns.
3. Save the .xlsx file and open it in Excel, Numbers, LibreOffice or Google Sheets.

Questions:
- Are amounts real numbers? Yes. Amounts like 1.234,50 or 1,234.50 become numbers, so you can sum and sort them.
- Does it work on scans? A scan is a picture with no text. Run OCR: make a PDF searchable first, then convert the result.

### Compress video
https://lunaverta.com/compress-video/

Make a phone video small enough to send. Pick how small, and your browser re-encodes it on your own device; the sound is kept as it is. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose an MP4 or MOV video, or drop it on the page.
2. Pick Smallest, Balanced or Best quality.
3. Save the smaller MP4.

Questions:
- How much smaller does it get? Phone videos usually shrink to a quarter or less with Smallest or Balanced, depending on the video.
- Which browsers can do it? Recent Chrome, Edge and Safari. It uses the video encoder built into the browser, so a newer device is faster.

### PowerPoint to PDF
https://lunaverta.com/powerpoint-to-pdf/

Turn a .pptx presentation into a PDF you can send to anyone, one slide per page, with real text you can search and copy. It all happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a .pptx file, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta reads each slide and draws it on its own PDF page.
3. Save the PDF.

Questions:
- Does it look exactly like PowerPoint? Text, bullets, pictures, tables and simple shapes come out close, with the colours of your theme. Charts, SmartArt, shadows and animations are left out or simplified, and fonts are replaced by standard ones.
- Can I select the text in the PDF? Yes. The text stays real text, so it can be searched, selected and copied.

### Make a fillable PDF
https://lunaverta.com/make-fillable-pdf/

Add boxes to a PDF where people can type or tick, and send it as a real form they can fill in on their computer or phone. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose the PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Pick the kind of field, then drag a box where people should type or tick.
3. Save the PDF. Anyone can now fill it in with an ordinary PDF reader.

Questions:
- Which kinds of fields can I add? Text lines, text boxes with several lines, and tick boxes.
- Can people fill it in on a phone? Yes. The fields are standard PDF form fields, so they work in Adobe Reader, Preview, Edge, Chrome and most phone PDF apps, and in LunaVerta's Fill in PDF form.

### QR code generator
https://lunaverta.com/qr-code-generator/

Make a QR code for a link, your Wi-Fi or a contact card. The code holds the text itself, so there is no redirect link, no tracking and nothing that expires. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Pick Link or text, Wi-Fi or Contact card.
2. Type the details; the code updates as you type.
3. Save it as PNG for printing and sharing, or SVG for any size.

Questions:
- Does the QR code expire? No. Many sites make codes that point to their own server, so they can count scans or stop working. These codes hold your text directly and work forever.
- How does the Wi-Fi code work? Guests point their phone camera at it and join your network without typing the password.
- Can I put my company logo in the middle? Yes. Add a PNG, JPG or SVG logo and choose its size. The code then gets the strongest error correction, so phones still read it.

### Video to GIF
https://lunaverta.com/video-to-gif/

Turn the opening seconds of an MP4, WebM or MOV video into an animated GIF. Choose 3, 5 or 10 seconds. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a video, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta turns the first seconds into a GIF.
3. Save the GIF.

Questions:
- How long can the GIF be? Choose the first 3, 5 or 10 seconds under GIF from video.
- Which video formats work? MP4, WebM, MOV and others your browser can play.

### Video to MP3
https://lunaverta.com/video-to-mp3/

Pull the soundtrack out of a video, or turn WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC into MP3. Choose 128, 192 or 320 kbps. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a video or audio file, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta converts the sound to MP3.
3. Save the MP3.

Questions:
- Which bitrate should I pick? 192 kbps is a good balance. Use 320 kbps for the best quality, or 128 kbps for small files such as speech.
- Can I get WAV instead? Yes. Pick WAV in the ring for uncompressed sound.

### PDF to Word
https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-word/

Get a PDF into Word with its look intact: fonts, sizes, bold and italic, colours, centred and indented paragraphs, columns, pictures and the page size. The paragraphs are real paragraphs, so the text flows when you edit it.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta reads the text on each page and builds a .docx file.
3. Save it and open it in Word, Pages, LibreOffice or Google Docs.

Questions:
- Will it look exactly like the PDF? Very close for letters, reports and similar documents. Lines and borders in tables, and very complex layouts, are not copied exactly, so check the result. If you only need to fix a few words, Edit PDF keeps the PDF exactly as it is.
- Does it work on scanned PDFs? Only if the scan has a text layer. Run OCR first to make a scan searchable, then convert it to Word.
- Is my PDF uploaded? No. The Word file is made in your browser.

### Compare two PDFs
https://lunaverta.com/compare-pdf/

Got a new version of a contract, quote or report? Choose the old and the new PDF, and LunaVerta shows what was added, removed and changed, side by side, down to the word.

Steps:
1. Choose two PDFs: first the old version, then the new one. Or drop both on the page.
2. LunaVerta reads the text in both and lines them up.
3. Read the changes side by side. Tick Only changes to hide everything that is the same.

Questions:
- What does it compare? The text, line by line and word by word. Changes to pictures, colours or layout are not shown.
- Which file is the old one? The first file you choose is the old version and the second is the new one. If you add more than two, the last two are compared.
- Are my PDFs uploaded? No. Both files are read and compared in your browser.
- Can I see the changes on the pages themselves? Yes. Press Pages to see both versions side by side, page by page, with removed text marked in red and new text in green.

### Extract PDF pages
https://lunaverta.com/extract-pdf-pages/

Need only part of a PDF? Type the pages you want, such as 1-3, 5, 8-10, and LunaVerta makes a new PDF with just those pages, in the order you typed. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Type the pages to keep, for example 2-5, 9.
3. Save the new PDF. Your original is not changed.

Questions:
- Can I change the order of the pages? Yes. The pages come out in the order you type them, so 5, 1-3 puts page 5 first.
- What does 8- mean? From page 8 to the end. Likewise, -3 means the first three pages.
- Is my PDF uploaded? No. The new PDF is made in your browser.

### Compress image
https://lunaverta.com/compress-image/

Make a photo small enough for e-mail, a form or a website. Choose the quality and see the new file size straight away, before you save. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose one or more pictures, or drop them on the page.
2. Move the quality slider, and change the size or format if you like. The new file size is shown as you go.
3. Press Save. The smaller pictures are saved on your device.

Questions:
- How much smaller does it get? Photos often shrink by 70 to 90% with almost no visible difference, especially when you also make them a bit smaller, for example 50%.
- Are the location and camera details removed? Yes. The picture is drawn again, so GPS location and other hidden data are not carried over.
- Are my pictures uploaded? No. Everything happens in your browser.

### Resize image
https://lunaverta.com/resize-image/

Make pictures smaller in width and height, for a website, a profile or a document. Pick 75%, 50% or 25%, or type an exact width. The proportions are kept. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose one or more pictures, or drop them on the page.
2. Pick a size, or choose Width and type it in pixels.
3. Press Save. The resized pictures are saved on your device.

Questions:
- Can I make a picture bigger? No. Enlarging only makes a picture blurry, so LunaVerta never makes it larger than it is.
- Can I resize many pictures at once? Yes. Choose them all; the size you pick is used for every one, and you can save them together as a .zip.

### Crop image
https://lunaverta.com/crop-image/

Cut away what you don't need. Drag the frame over the part to keep, choose a square for a profile picture, or 4:3 or 16:9 for slides and video. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a picture, or drop it on the page.
2. Pick Square, 4:3, 16:9 or Free, then drag the frame and its corners.
3. Press Save. The cropped picture is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Can I crop several pictures at once? Cropping works on one picture at a time, because each needs its own frame. Size, format and quality can be changed for many at once.
- Does cropping lower the quality? No. The part you keep stays as sharp as before. Choose PNG to keep it lossless.

### Scan to PDF
https://lunaverta.com/scan-to-pdf/

Photograph a letter, receipt or form, and LunaVerta finds the paper, straightens it, evens out shadows and makes a PDF. Add as many pages as you need, and make the text searchable with OCR. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Press Choose files and take a photo, or choose photos you already have.
2. Check the four corners, pick colour, grey or black and white, and add more pages.
3. Press Make PDF. The PDF is saved on your device.

Questions:
- Does it work on a computer too? Yes. Choose photos or scans from your computer, and they are straightened and turned into a PDF the same way.
- The corners are wrong. What do I do? Drag the four round handles onto the corners of the paper. It works best with the paper on a darker surface.
- Are my photos uploaded? No. Everything, including the text recognition, happens on your device.

### Alternate merge
https://lunaverta.com/alternate-merge-pdf/

Scanners that only scan one side give you two files: all the fronts, then all the backs. This puts them together page by page, even when the backs come in reverse. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose the PDF with the front pages, then the one with the back pages (or one PDF with both halves).
2. Tick whether the back pages are in reverse order, as they usually are.
3. Save the combined PDF.

Questions:
- Why are the backs often reversed? When you turn the stack over to scan the backs, the last page comes first. Leave the box ticked and they are put the right way round.
- Can it be one file? Yes. If one PDF has all the fronts followed by all the backs, the first half is used as fronts and the second half as backs.

### Remove blank pages
https://lunaverta.com/remove-blank-pages-from-pdf/

Double-sided scans are full of empty backs. LunaVerta finds the pages with nothing on them and takes them out, so only the pages that matter are left. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Every page is checked; pages with nothing printed on them are removed.
3. Save the shorter PDF.

Questions:
- What counts as blank? A page with almost nothing printed on it. Scanner specks and a lone page number still count as blank.
- What if a page is wrongly removed? Your original is never changed, so you can always go back. Faint pages, such as pencil notes, may look blank.

### Flatten PDF form
https://lunaverta.com/flatten-pdf/

After filling in a form, flatten it: the fields and what you typed become ordinary text on the page, so nobody can change them and every PDF reader shows them the same. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose the filled-in PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Every form field becomes fixed text in its place.
3. Save the flattened PDF and send that one.

Questions:
- Why flatten a form? Fields can be changed by the next person, and some readers show them differently or not at all. A flattened form looks the same everywhere and cannot be edited by accident.
- Can I still change it afterwards? Not as a form. Keep your original if you might need to edit the answers.

### Greyscale PDF
https://lunaverta.com/greyscale-pdf/

Make a colour PDF grey for cheaper printing on a black-and-white printer, or simply a calmer look. The text can still be searched and copied. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Every page is redrawn in shades of grey.
3. Save the greyscale PDF.

Questions:
- Can I still search the text? Yes. The text is kept as an invisible layer on each page, so you can search and copy it.
- Does it change the quality? Pages are redrawn at good print quality. Links and form fields are not kept, so keep the original for filling in.

### Repair PDF
https://lunaverta.com/repair-pdf/

A PDF that will not open, shows errors or was cut off during a download can often be saved. LunaVerta reads it leniently and writes a clean, working copy. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose the damaged PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta rebuilds the file from whatever it can read.
3. Save the repaired copy.

Questions:
- Can every PDF be repaired? No. If a large part of the file is missing, the missing pages cannot be brought back, but what remains is usually saved.
- Is my original changed? No. You get a new copy, and the original stays as it was.

### Edit PDF details
https://lunaverta.com/edit-pdf-metadata/

The title stored in a PDF is what shows in browser tabs and search results instead of the file name. Set the title, author, subject and keywords, or clear them. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Change the title, author, subject or keywords.
3. Save the PDF with the new details.

Questions:
- Where do these details show? In the title bar of PDF readers and browsers, in the file properties, and often in search results when the PDF is online.
- Can I remove details instead? Yes. Leave the fields empty and tick the box to also remove the program name and dates. Remove PDF metadata removes everything at once.

### Extract images from PDF
https://lunaverta.com/extract-images-from-pdf/

Get the photos and pictures out of a PDF as separate files, in the size they are stored in the PDF, not as screenshots. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Every picture in it is found and saved as its own file.
3. Save them one by one, or all at once as a .zip.

Questions:
- Which format do the pictures get? Photos are saved as JPG, and graphics, logos and pictures with transparency as PNG.
- Why is a picture missing? Very small bits, such as lines and dots, are skipped, and drawings made of lines rather than pictures cannot be extracted. Use PDF to JPG to save whole pages.

### Booklet & pages per sheet
https://lunaverta.com/pdf-booklet/

Turn a PDF into a booklet you fold and staple, with the pages in exactly the right printing order, or fit 2 or 4 pages on each sheet to save paper. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Pick Booklet, 2 pages per sheet or 4 pages per sheet.
3. Save the PDF and print it.

Questions:
- How do I print the booklet? Print on both sides and choose "flip on short edge". Fold the stack in the middle and staple it on the fold.
- What if the page count is not a multiple of 4? Empty pages are added at the end so the booklet folds correctly.

### Crop PDF & page size
https://lunaverta.com/crop-pdf/

Trim the empty margins so the content fills the page, or put every page on the same paper size when a PDF mixes sizes. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Pick Trim white margins, Make every page A4 or Make every page US Letter.
3. Save the new PDF.

Questions:
- Is anything deleted when trimming? No. The margins are hidden, not removed, so the content and its quality stay the same.
- What happens to pages of a different shape? They are scaled to fit the paper size without stretching; wide pages are turned sideways.

### Header & footer
https://lunaverta.com/add-header-footer-to-pdf/

Write a line for the top or bottom of every page, such as "Confidential", a case number or the date. Page numbers and the file name can be filled in for you. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. Type the header and/or footer and pick where it goes.
3. Save the PDF with the new header and footer.

Questions:
- What can I put in the text? Any text, plus {page} for the page number, {pages} for the number of pages, {date} for today and {name} for the file name.
- Can I leave the first page out? Yes. Tick Not on the first page, for example for a cover page.

### PDF to text
https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-text/

Copy all the text out of a PDF into a plain .txt file, page by page. Useful for quotes, notes and further editing. Nothing is uploaded.

Steps:
1. Choose a PDF, or drop it on the page.
2. LunaVerta reads the text on every page.
3. Save the .txt file.

Questions:
- Does it work on scanned PDFs? Only if the scan already has a text layer. Plain scans are pictures with no text to extract.
- Is the layout kept? Line breaks are kept, but columns and tables become plain text.

## Guides

### Remove a CPR number from a PDF
https://lunaverta.com/guide/remove-cpr-number-from-pdf/

A CPR number on a document you share can be misused. Here is how to remove it properly, so it is really gone from the file and not just hidden.

Step by step:
1. Open Anonymise PDF and choose your PDF.
2. LunaVerta looks through every page and marks CPR numbers in yellow, along with other things people usually remove, such as account numbers, e-mails and phone numbers.
3. If you only want to remove the CPR number, switch the other categories off. Tap a marking to keep that piece of text.
4. Click Remove … and save new version. The marked text is deleted from the file, and a copy is saved on your device. Your original is not changed.
Why a black box in Word or a PDF reader is not enough:
Drawing a black rectangle over a number usually only covers it. The text is still underneath, and anyone can copy it out or find it with a search. LunaVerta deletes the letters themselves, so there is nothing left to copy.
Check the result:
Open the saved PDF, press Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F on a Mac) and search for the first digits of the number. Nothing should be found.
Scanned documents:
If the PDF is a scan (a picture of paper), there is no text to search. Use Black out in the same window and drag a box over the number yourself; it is burned into the picture when you save.

### Share a payslip safely
https://lunaverta.com/guide/share-payslip-safely/

Landlords, banks and new employers often ask to see a payslip. They need your income, not your CPR number or bank account. Here is how to send only what they need.

Step by step:
1. Open Anonymise PDF and choose the payslip.
2. Your CPR number, account numbers, e-mail and phone number are found and marked in yellow.
3. Keep what the receiver needs to see. If the pay amounts are marked, switch the Prices category off so they stay.
4. Click Remove … and save new version, and send the saved copy.
What to remove, and what to keep:
- Remove: CPR number, bank account and registration number, tax card details you were not asked for, your home address if the receiver already has it.
- Keep: your name, the employer, the period and the pay amounts. That is usually what the receiver needs to check.
Several months?:
If you are asked for three months, anonymise each payslip, then put them together with Merge PDF so you only send one file.

### Sign a rental contract without printing
https://lunaverta.com/guide/sign-lease-without-printing/

You have received a lease as a PDF and need to sign it. You do not need a printer and a scanner: you can sign it on your computer or phone in a minute.

Step by step:
1. Open Sign PDF and choose the contract.
2. Draw your signature with the mouse or your finger. Tick Add today’s date under the signature if you want the date there.
3. Click Place on page, then click where the signature should go. Go to other pages and click again if they also need signing or initials.
4. Click Save PDF, and send the signed copy back.
Is a drawn signature valid?:
A drawn signature on a PDF is a simple electronic signature. Many landlords and companies accept it for leases and everyday contracts, but some documents require a stronger signature such as MitID. If you are unsure, ask the person who sent you the contract whether they accept it. This is not legal advice.
Signing often?:
Tick Remember on this device, and it is stored on your own device, ready for next time. It is never sent anywhere.

### Collect receipts in one PDF
https://lunaverta.com/guide/combine-receipts-into-one-pdf/

Insurance claims, expense reports and tax deductions often need the receipts as one file. Here is how to go from a pile of paper to one tidy PDF, using just your phone.

Step by step:
1. Open Scan to PDF on your phone and take a photo of the first receipt.
2. The edges are found and the receipt is straightened, like a real scan. Click Add a page and photograph the next one. Repeat for all of them.
3. Tick Make the text searchable, so you can search the amounts later.
4. Click Make PDF, then Save. All the receipts are now one file.
Some receipts are already PDFs?:
Save your scan, then put it together with the other PDFs in Merge PDF.
Too big to e-mail?:
Many mail services stop at 20–25 MB. Compress PDF makes the file smaller without making the receipts hard to read.

### Turn iPhone photos (HEIC) into JPG
https://lunaverta.com/guide/iphone-photos-heic-to-jpg/

iPhones save photos as HEIC to save space. That is fine on the phone, but many Windows PCs, websites and forms will not take them. Here is how to turn them into ordinary JPG photos.

Step by step:
1. Open HEIC to JPG.
2. Choose your HEIC photos, or drop them on the page. You can take many at once.
3. They are turned into JPG straight away, on your device.
4. Click Save on each one, or save them all at once as a .zip.
Is the quality the same?:
The photo looks the same. JPG files are a bit bigger than HEIC, which is the price of being readable everywhere. If you need them smaller, for example for a web form with a size limit, use Compress image afterwards.
Location and other hidden data:
Photos from a phone usually carry the place they were taken. If you are sharing them with strangers, run them through Remove photo location as well.
Stop the iPhone making HEIC:
On the iPhone, go to Settings › Camera › Formats and choose Most Compatible. New photos are then saved as JPG. Photos you have already taken stay HEIC.

### Make a PDF small enough to e-mail
https://lunaverta.com/guide/make-pdf-small-enough-to-email/

Your PDF is too big to attach. Most mail services stop at 20 to 25 MB, and some companies set an even lower limit. Here is how to make it small enough.

Step by step:
1. Open Compress PDF and choose the PDF.
2. Every page is redrawn more compactly. The text stays searchable and can still be copied.
3. You see how much smaller it became. Click Save.
4. If it could not get smaller, you get your original back unchanged.
What makes PDFs big:
Almost always pictures: scans, photos and phone snaps of paper. A 30-page scan can easily be 40 MB; after compressing it is often a few MB. PDFs that are mostly typed text are usually small already, and compressing them does little.
Still too big?:
- Split it: Split PDF makes one file per page, and Extract pages lets you send only the pages that matter.
- Send it in parts, one attachment per e-mail.
When not to compress:
Compressing turns the pages into pictures with the text kept on top, so links and fillable form fields are not kept. If the receiver has to fill in or sign the form, send the original.

### Remove the location from photos before you share them
https://lunaverta.com/guide/remove-location-before-sharing-photos/

Most phone photos quietly record where they were taken. A photo of the sofa you are selling can tell a stranger where you live. Here is how to remove that before you share.

Step by step:
1. Open Remove photo location.
2. Choose your photos, or drop them on the page.
3. The location, camera details, dates and other hidden data are removed. The picture itself is not touched, so there is no loss of quality.
4. Save the cleaned photos and share those instead of the originals.
Doesn't the website remove it anyway?:
Some big sites remove the location when you upload, but you cannot always tell, and photos sent by e-mail, as files in a chat or on a USB stick usually keep it. Cleaning them first means you do not have to rely on anyone else.
Turn it off for future photos:
- iPhone: Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services › Camera › Never.
- Android: open the Camera app, go to its settings and switch off location tags (the name varies by phone).

### Turn a PDF into Word and keep the layout
https://lunaverta.com/guide/pdf-to-word-keep-layout/

You need to change a document you only have as a PDF. Here is how to turn it into a Word file you can edit, with the fonts, bold text, alignment and pictures kept.

Step by step:
1. Open PDF to Word and choose the PDF.
2. The text on each page is read and built into a .docx file, with paragraphs, fonts, sizes, bold and italic, alignment and pictures.
3. Click Save.
4. Open it in Word, Pages, LibreOffice or Google Docs and edit away.
Only need to fix a few words?:
Then you may not need Word at all. Edit PDF lets you correct text directly in the PDF, in its own font, and the rest of the page stays exactly as it was.
Scanned PDFs:
A scan is a picture of paper, so there is no text to read. Run it through OCR: make a PDF searchable first, then convert the result to Word.
What does not carry over:
Complicated layouts, such as text in many columns, tables drawn with lines, or text on top of pictures, may need some tidying in Word afterwards.
